preclaim: require transport proof and exact current incarnations
claim.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY until typed evidence proves non-effect or source stale/dead

elastic.ready_unleased: count(READY semantic points without satisfaction proof or exact active lease)
elastic.active_fenced: count(LEASED|RUNNING points with exact current fence+transport proof)
elastic.dispatchable_idle: verified idle agents with current transport proof+incarnation
elastic.pending_supply: PROVISIONING|BOUND_UNVERIFIED only while typed inventory says non-ambiguous and proof deadline valid
elastic.scale_down: only typed VERIFIED_IDLE; never infer death/loss from UI/page/activity/ambiguity

points.objective: Mount Monaco in the DevOS IDE shell with deterministic worker/asset lifecycle and no remote eval.
Define canonical document URI/model/version/dirty-state semantics independent of storage transport.
Define open/save adapter boundary with explicit pre-effect durability and development-only authority.
Integrate Monaco shell, document identity, and save boundary behind one typed IDE contract.
Mount xterm UI as a renderer-only terminal surface with explicit session identity.
Define typed PTY protocol for create/input/output/resize/exit with sequence and session fences.
Implement PTY host/process lifecycle behind an isolated authority boundary.
Integrate flow control, resize, backpressure, reconnect, and terminal transcript boundaries.
Create explicit Tree-sitter language/parser registry with pinned parser provenance.
Map Monaco document versions and edits deterministically into incremental parse edits.
Define AST query/extraction contract for symbols, scopes, imports, calls, and source ranges.
Integrate registry, incremental parsing, and semantic extraction with bounded resource behavior.
Define LSP server process/transport lifecycle with exact server incarnation binding.
Map Monaco document identity/versioning into didOpen/didChange/didSave/didClose semantics.
Project diagnostics into Monaco only when document/version/server incarnation still match.
Integrate hover/completion/definition/references as cancellable read paths.
Gate rename/codeAction/workspace edits through durable typed edit plans and explicit effect receipts.
Define Code Knowledge Graph node/edge schema, stable IDs, document-version and provenance fields.
Ingest Tree-sitter symbol/scope/import/call facts incrementally.
Enrich graph with LSP definitions/references/types while preserving source provenance and incarnation.
Implement transactional invalidation/rebuild semantics for changed documents and dependency fanout.
Expose bounded read-only graph queries for context assembly and agent reasoning.
Compare the diverged R10 context-compiler line against current base/target and extract only proven reusable contracts/tests.
Feed Monaco document state and Code Knowledge Graph query results into R10 through typed bounded context inputs.
Preserve R10 deterministic visible-agent target projection and terminal-only-when-available semantics while adding IDE context.
Seal DEVOS_IDE_V1 with end-to-end deterministic context compilation from editor/terminal/parser/LSP/graph snapshots.

rules: BLOCKED->READY only after authoritative dependency evidence
READY->LEASED only after dedupe+satisfaction probe+exact fence
LEASED->RUNNING only after live revalidation+transport proof
RUNNING->SATISFIED only with durable semantic completion evidence
pre-actuation failure may return READY only after proven lease release
